findings.citation_text: The second type of MSPs is generated due to the frequency difference (FD) between the pair of displaying and imaging devices in the recapturing process [36]. According to Eq. (3), the spectral model shows a convolution operation between two Dirac comb functions.
findings.reasoning: The citing paper directly uses [36] to explain the generation of moiré spectral peaks from frequency difference and refers to the spectral model involving convolution, which is the core theoretical contribution of the cited paper.
